dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the Yuhaaviatam of San Manuel Nation and visitors or managers of the San Bernardino National Forest.
dimensions.evidence: authorizes a land exchange between the Yuhaaviatam of San Manuel Nation... and the federal government.

dimensions.assessment: Transfers specific land parcels and requires a cultural preservation agreement for a specific landmark site.
dimensions.evidence: the Nation shall enter into an agreement with the Secretary under which the Nation agrees to preserve... the Arrowhead landmark site

dimensions.assessment: Requires the tribe to bear survey costs, with no direct federal appropriations specified.
dimensions.evidence: The cost of the survey in subparagraph (A) shall be borne by the Nation.

dimensions.assessment: Applies a targeted land conveyance and management change for specific acreage in California.
dimensions.evidence: To provide for a land exchange in San Bernardino County, California, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Permanently transfers land titles and establishes permanent National Forest management and cultural preservation agreements.
dimensions.evidence: Land acquired by the Secretary under this section shall become part of the San Bernardino National Forest

missing_information: Monetary appraised values of the lands being exchanged
importance_detail.rationale: Authorizes a specific land exchange of approximately 1,460 acres of tribal land for 1,475 acres of National Forest System land in California, subject to a preservation agreement.
